pages.text: The Akaishi Purifier, the "juicer" that squeezes rough akaishi blocks into akaishi essence.$(br)It's the very first consumer of energy — feed it a block, power it up, and essence rolls into the output slot. Your first power-hungry machine starts right here.

The Advanced Purifier block is a wall block of the Purifier Matrix.$(br)Enclose a 3×3×3 space with matrix casings, add a controller and ports, and purifying speed jumps 30×. The full matrix recipe is in the "Advanced Tech" chapter.
